# KaleemSolarPK Multan

> A-Grade solar panels, inverters, batteries, cables and mounting structures for homes, businesses and industries across Pakistan. Based in Multan, offering free delivery exclusively within Multan and nationwide shipping elsewhere. Open Mon–Sun (Friday closed), 10AM–6PM.
